scenario: [RARC.5.2.7]: the refused emit abandons the activation as every TypeError does -- the action before it stands and the one after it does not run ([LNUL.11.1]'s prefix rule) -- and the engine is intact: a later rule in the same pump fires, and the TypeError fault fact names the refused slot ([LERR.9.3]). `r` logs `before`, emits the Json leaf "alice" into the Int slot `Out.v`, and would log `after`; `later` logs `later`; `handler` matches the fault fact on its schema and slot. Exactly ["before", "later", "refused Out.v String"]: Mercury's old reject-only disposition logs `after`; libds's old -104 failed the pump before `later`; a refusal that named the expression's operand rather than the slot does not match `handler`. Path: libds rete/engine.c eval_actions (break on the latch), Mercury ds.exec.m assert_verb (abandon sets xs_capped).
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

schema Out scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Payload p
->
    log info "before"
    emit Out logical v: p.body.name
    log info "after"

rule later:
    Payload
->
    log info "later"

rule handler:
    TypeError e where e.schema == "Out" and e.slot == "v"
->
    log info "refused Out.v {e.actual}"
